[b]Hello, Players![/b]

We are excited to announce the upcoming updates and rewards designed to enhance the competitive experience in Mitos.is: The Game. These updates are aimed at recognizing the achievements of our top players. Here are the details:

[b][color=#00FFFF]Global Rank Titles[/color][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Top Player Rewards:[/b] The leading player globally in each game mode will receive the temporary title [b]"Master of Global"[/b] for one month. Additionally, this player will earn a permanent title, [b]"Best of Season XX."[/b]
[*][b]Current Season Inclusion:[/b] These titles and rewards will also be available this season. We encourage all players to compete and climb to the top of the leaderboards.
[/list]

[b][color=#00FFFF]Special Tournament Mode Titles for Next Season[/color][/b]
[list]
[*][b]New Titles:[/b] Starting next season, the top global player in Tournament Mode will be honored with a temporary title, [b]"Tournament Champion,"[/b] for one month, along with a permanent title, [b]"Champion of Season XX."[/b]
[*][b]Animated Skins:[/b] Winners will also receive unique animated skins to celebrate their victory.
[/list]

[b][color=#00FFFF]Premium Battle-Pass Gifts[/color][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Monthly Rewards:[/b] Each month, we will gift a 1-Tier premium Battle-Pass to top-ranked players in five randomly selected game modes from the following list: FFA, Solo Mode, Random Teams, Battle Royale, Human vs Zombie, Soccer Mode, Territory War, Capture the Flag, Crazy Mode, Split Party, 1 vs 1, 2 vs 2, and Tournaments.
[*][b]This Month’s Selected Modes:[/b] The modes selected for this month are Split Party, Territory War, FFA, Battle Royale, and Tournaments.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support and dedication to Mitos.is. We look forward to seeing how these new features enhance your gameplay experience.

[b]Best regards,[/b]
[b]The Mitos.is Team[/b]

notes.title: New Game Mode: 2 vs 2 Arena
notes.content:
Exciting news for all Mitos.is players! We're thrilled to introduce a brand-new game mode that will test your skills and teamwork: 2 vs 2 Arena. It's time to team up with a friend and face off in a dynamic and strategic environment.

Here's what you can expect in the 2 vs 2 Arena:
[list]
[*][b]Form Your Duo[/b]: Enter the arena and battle it out in teams of two. Pair up with a friend or get matched with an ally.
[*][b]Potion Strategy[/b]: Use up to three of your equipped potions for each match, adding a layer of strategy to your gameplay.
[*][b]Initial Mass Advantage[/b]: Start each match with a significant mass of 2,000.
[*][b]Challenging Respawns[/b]: Each respawn halves your initial mass, making every life count.
[*][b]Fair Play Environment[/b]: All Hyper Chance attributes are disabled in this mode, ensuring a balanced and skill-focused experience.
 [*][b]A Race for Mass[/b]: The duo with the highest combined mass at the end of 5 minutes claims victory.
 [*][b]Team Tactics[/b]: Work closely with your teammate, splitting and merging for tactical advantages. Enhance your strategy by splitting into your teammate for tactical plays and coordinated attacks.
 [*][b]Season Rewards Doubled[/b]: More at stake, more to win! The season rewards for this mode are doubled, beginning from the next season.
[/list]

Get ready to collaborate, strategize, and conquer in the 2 vs 2 Arena. Can you and your teammate rise to the top? Team up, strategize, and reign supreme in the arena!

Have fun,
Mitos.is Team

notes.title: MASSIVE GAME UPDATE + New Season + New Equips!
notes.content:
Dear Player,

The [i][u]new season[/u][/i] is upon us, and the thrill is real! Engage in captivating endeavors and spirited competition until the journey reaches its peak on [b]November 1st[/b].

We've been hard at work to bring some exciting new changes and improvements to the game! Here’s a quick rundown of what’s new:
[list]
[*][b]Evolutions Replace Leveling[/b]: Leveling has now metamorphosed into Evolutions, opening up a new dimension of progress and power in your hands.
[*][b]Titles Over Nickname TAGs[/b]: "Nickname TAGs" have evolved to "Titles," offering a crisp and apt description of your accolades.
[*][b]Title Instead of Battle-Tag[/b]: We’ve simplified things; the Battle-Tag is removed and replaced solely with "Title."
[*][b]Item Level[/b]: Equipment will now display an "Item Level" to swiftly guide you in identifying superior items.
[*][b]Legendary Evolution[/b]: Introducing a new evolution tier – the Legendary Evolution, set to amplify your game with superior power and style.
[*][b]Battle Pass and Premium Version[/b]: Explore the new Battle Pass with monthly-resetting objectives and exclusive perks. Moreover, with the Premium Battle Pass, bask in additional rewards, free equipment, 3-letter usernames, and more, refreshed each month.
[/list]

That's not all!
Peek into the future:
[list]
[*][b]Equip Store Rework[/b]: A comprehensive equipment store rework is underway and will span several days, injecting fresh excitement into your gameplay.
[*][b]New Legendary Items[/b]: Legendary items have now landed across all categories for you to claim and conquer!
[*][b]Items Schedule[/b]: Beginning next week, expect a new legendary item to grace the game every Friday, progressively adding to the existing assortment.
[*][b]Beginner-Friendly Mode[/b]: Introducing a new game mode designed for newcomers, offering a fun and safe environment up to the Diamond evolution.
[/list]

And don't forget - our [b]Halloween[/b] 🎃 event is lurking just around the corner! Keep your eyes peeled for more spooky details soon.

Thank you for continuing this journey with us. Your passion and feedback have been instrumental in shaping these updates, and we're excited to venture into this new season together!
Whether battling or evolving, fun is the ultimate conquest!

Happy gaming,
The Freakinware Team!

notes.title: Season 9 Announcement!
notes.content:
Dear Player,

Season 9 has begun! Discover all the new features:

- Emerald Evolution:
  The new evolution has arrived! It will provide +13% stats bonus of your
  equipment and unlocks new emerald items! The new evolution will bring you back
  to level 69.

- New Emerald Jewelery
  New set of 4 powerful emerald jewels which will provide you incredible powerful
  stats!

- New Competitive Play
  Until now the only way to play competitive matches was in guild, starting from season 9
  players can play competitive matches in solo or in a party. Winning or losing a
  competitive game will increase or decrease your personal rating, which is the same used
  in guild wars. There will be a new player ranks too!

- New Guild features:

1) Guild War CO-OP
   Until now guild wars have been unoptimized, due to guild playing with only 2 players
   against 4 or more players. Starting from season 9 guilds can be inserted in the same team
   to fight against other guilds in the same number. Players playing in competitive mode can be
   inserted in a guild team too. The guild owner can disable the external collaboration option in the
   guild settings
 
2) Guild Server
   The guild owner will be able to change the server in the settings screen.

3) Guild Advertising
   The guild owner will be able to advertise the guild to make it appear first in the guild search
   page. The first time is free.

4) Improved Match results
   When a Guild War or a competitive match ends there will be displayed more detailed statistics about
   the ended game.

6) Guild Search
   Now you'll be able to search for a particular guild in the "Find a Guild" screen.

7) Friend Search
   Likewise the guilds search you'll be able to filter your friends in the Friend List in the right panel.

8) Emeralds
   While in the special daily game mode players can collect diamonds, in guild wars and competitive 
   matches players will be able to collect emeralds and exchange them from coins.

- Playgrounds (coming next week)
  Playgrounds are special rooms, started by the staff and with a limited duration, where the
  player attributes can be heavily twisted, for example super speed, super eat distance, fast grow
  and so on.

This update will also incluse tons of bug fixes and improvements.

EDIT: 
The update is already online, in the upcoming days we will balance the game and fix all reported bugs.

Thank you, and have fun!
Freakinware Team

notes.title: - New Game Mode + Double Coins + Updates!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are proud to announce the following changes:

- Double Coins Weekend!
  
  ** For each coin pack you purchase during the weekend you get double coins! **

- New Game Mode: Team Fortress!
 
  This mini-game is played by two teams and is composed by two alternate phases:
  
  1. Attack Phase
     Convoy the payload to the opposite fortress: during the attack phase stay close
     to the payload to make it move and feed it to speed it up! When the payload reaches the
     center of the map you have to fill it up feeding it for a total of [strike]200[/strike] 100 mass. After that
     you have to make it reach the opposite base.

  2. Defense phase
     During the defense phase feed the payload to slow its route and defeat the enemies nearby
     to make it stop.
  
  You have about 4 minutes to make the payload reach the opposite base, otherwise you lose.

  ** This game mode is in beta test, and could be removed from the game **


- Free For All

  1. We have increased the amount of food available by 10%  
  
- Deathmatch Mode:

  1. In deathmatch mode we have added red spawners that will spawn food around them, they are
  also capable to eat smaller players and the eaten mass will be ejected around the cell. If a bigger
  cell eats a red spawner it will experience the same effect of red bubble viruses.

  [strike]2. Feeding a virus now makes it move instead of split.[/strike]

- Guild player limit

  1. We have reduced guild limit to 50 players, in order to urge the best players create more
     guilds instead of playing all in the same.

- Portal weapon

  1. The portal will can now trepass the borders of the map like it woul behave in a sphere.

Feel free to leave your suggestion or contact us at admin@nilwave.com

Thank you much for playing!
Mitos.is Team

notes.title: ** Guild War, Pets and Balancing updates ! **
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We want to announce the following changes :

* Teaming Fatigue **UPDATED**

FFA will NOT be affected by teaming fatigue, but people teaming will not gain experience eating each other.

For people teaming in Deatchmatch and Hunger Games teaming fatigue will now apply a speed malus up to -30%.

* Deatmatch *

Since it is now very difficult to team with the new added speed malus, in Deathmatch we have restored skins and real names, this will make Deathmatch mode more appealing.

* Pets *

We have reworked pets to make them more useful:

a) Pets will now share 30% of their speed bonus with the player
b) You can recall your pet anytime and it will instantly rejoin into your biggest cell
c) When you split or lose mass your pet will automatically feed your biggest cell (instead of losing mass)

* Guild War *

Each Wednesday, the system will automatically distribute the 80% (max 10k coins) of the guild bank coins to the players 
who have played, with this formula:

1 match = 1 pt
1 win   = 2 pt

So for example, if the guild bank has 12500 coins, at the end of the week
10000 coins (80%) will be distributed this way:

 player a) 10 victories (20 pts)
 player b) 5 victories 5 defeats (15 pts)
 player c) 10 defeats (10 pts)

 player a will get 4444 coins,
 player b will get 3333 coins
 player c will get 2223 coins

The guild leader is still able to manually send a low amount of coins.

** Tomorrow Feb 13 we will release Ruby Evolution **

Stay tuned and have fun!
Mitos.is Team

notes.title: Mitos.is Back On Steam!
notes.content:
Finally Mitos.is is back on steam, we had been taken down by a "DMCA claim" from those nice people of Agar.io (Miniclip).

They have already tried to stop our business several times, but they never succeeded. 

Certainly that is not a fair way to make business, you cannot just ask a game for removal because of similar game mechanics, games are not just their mechanics. The funny thing is that Agar.io is not the first game with a cell-eat-cell mechanics (Spore by EA)!

Matheus Valadares, the original developer of Agar.io (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Agar.io), did make his version of Flappy Bird: flapmmo.com, nevertheless the original author of Flappy Bird didn't ask him to remove his game.

The majority of the games out there share the same mechanics, and for the players this is just a good thing, they have more choice and force the developers to improve their games.

FIFA is not the only soccer game, Call Of Duty is not the only war game, WoW is not the only mmorpg game, and what about Candy Crush, Flappy Bird and so on?

Anyway we are going to upload a big update very soon:

- Hunger Games mode
- Private rooms
- Lucky chests
- Improved guild management and bank
- New equipments and items

Thank you much and enjoy the game!
